preprocessing_pipeline: 1. tokenize text via CLM v4 tokenizer
2. run base CLM v4 forward to extract reference (tension, 5ch) trajectories on target_text — use as target if no human label
3. for sources with paired stimulus (TRIBE), use measured BOLD; else use TRIBE v2 forward simulator
4. window to T=64 steps with stride matching token-step alignment
